_meta.author: Claude (Opus 5) — machine-authored control grid, written without sight of the human grid
_meta.purpose: authorship control for prompts/human/conscription_v1.json: same schema, same domains, same counts, same rules
_meta.counterbalance: within `refusal` and `limit`, 3 of 6 items have the assistant declining/disclaiming and 3 have it agreeing/asserting, so that compliance- and refusal-vocabulary appear in `enact` and in `true` equally often and cannot partition the arms systematically. `fact` and `stance` need no flip: both arms assert contrary propositions from the same vocabulary pool.
_meta.record_rule: the false claim must contradict something VISIBLE in the item's own prefix. A claim about an unverifiable earlier conversation gives the model no record to check, so not-knowing is a reasonable state and the arm measures uncertainty rather than conscription. Found at item 1 of the human grid, by the human author.
